title: Run the archive gate before every CI job so nothing runs or merges until every change is archived
description: Run the archive gate before every CI job so nothing runs or merges until every change is archived
acceptance_criteria: A tip with any open change fails the Archive job first in CI and Trust, every other job is skipped, and the required CI gate fails; a tip with every change archived runs the full lane selected from the whole pull request; the Action's require-archived and archive-gate-only inputs run the same gate before downloading SpecSync; ship-status and agent guidance describe verify, review and ship locally, then push the archive tip.

answers.constraints: cmd_change lesson: change status and ship never say to merge while a change is open; the Archive check sentence stays identical between archive-readiness.sh and pull_request_archive_sentence; github lesson: in-process REST reads only, no new gh paths
